OmaStats 1.5.1 stops its text fields from reading the clipboard when another application changes it.

[Download the complete plugin](https://github.com/crmne/omastats/releases/download/v1.5.1/omastats-v1.5.1.tar.gz), or install it with:

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omastats.git --enable
```

## Fixed

- **Text fields leave the clipboard alone until you type in them.** Qt asks the clipboard for text whenever another application changes it, for every editable text field. The process search field exists, hidden, whenever a page with a process list is open, so another application could make the shell read whatever it offered without you pasting anything. The process search and the utilization color fields are now read-only until they have focus. Clicking a field or pressing `/` still focuses it for typing. By @crmne; thanks @HANCORE-linux (omacom/omarchy-plugin-marketplace#11213).

## Known limitations

- Version 1.4.1 and earlier can't read a disk saved by id. If you go back to an older version, choose the disk again in Settings.
- A mirror, raidz or striped ZFS pool counts against its first data drive only. "All disks" is correct, but picking another drive in the pool shows no space for it.
- A vertical bar with many readouts turned on can run into the bar's center section. Turn off readouts you don't need, or use figure-only looks.

## Thanks

Thanks @HANCORE-linux for reporting the clipboard read during the marketplace review.

Both bundled binaries are rebuilt twice in CI, compared byte-for-byte with the committed executables, and covered by checksums and GitHub build attestations.
